assessment: Two concrete misses were larger year-end 2024 repo usage and the HDFC price floor. QT timing and deposit-led balance-sheet repair were supported. HDFC returns over the stated long horizon and Bitcoin quantum migration remain open. Accounting implementation dates and shareholder-proposal exclusion must be described precisely.
